0022600090.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the New Orleans Pelicans host the Indiana Pacers. The teams split their two meetings in 2025-26, and their most recent game was a 127-119 Pelicans loss in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026, while Indiana is missing Johnny Furphy, who is out with a knee issue listed as surgery. ESPN's matchup predictor gives New Orleans a 35% chance to win.
